blocks.text: Origin / creation. Ecologists, world maintainers, residents, archivists, and continuity representatives were assigned to decide which regions, cycles, species, routes, and cultural anchors could remain active.
Identity / human status. Artificial stewardship coalitions.
Importance. Their selections determined the habitable environments, ruins, sleeping archives, migration routes, and contradictions inherited by Era Three.
Decline or loss. The work ended as worlds were folded and active regions stabilized. Stewards expired, withdrew, entered reduction, or became unable to maintain complete expertise.
Final status / surviving function. No complete steward order remains. Automatic ecological thresholds, sealed regions, and Pathkeeper knowledge carry fragments of their function.
